map.输入日期（或直接输入月龄天数），计算月龄、照明率、月相名称与月升月落估算: Enter a date (or directly enter the moon age in days) to compute the moon age, illumination fraction, phase name and moonrise/moonset estimate
map.📖 查看「月相照明率计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Moon Phase Illumination Calculation User Guide"
map.💡 月相周期（朔望月）约 29.5306 天，参考新月时刻 2000-01-06: 💡 The moon phase cycle (synodic month) is about 29.5306 days, with the reference new moon at 2000-01-06 18:14 UTC. Moonrise/moonset are geometric estimates, affected by latitude and season.
map.快速计算，结果可一键复制: quick calculation; the result can be copied in one click
map.月相名称按 8 分位划分，每段约 3.69 天: Phase names are divided into 8 segments of about 3.69 days each
map.月升月落按“每日推迟约 50 分钟”规律估算，仅供参考: Moonrise/moonset are estimated by the rule of "about 50 minutes later each day", for reference only
map.由一种量推另一种（如露点、水汽压）。: Derive one quantity from another (e.g. dew point, vapor pressure).
map.报表统一量纲便于对比。: Unify units in reports for comparison.
map.标准大气压 1013.25 hPa = 760 mmHg = 1 atm；某日: Standard atmosphere 1013.25 hPa = 760 mmHg = 1 atm; on a given day 900 hPa ≈ 675 mmHg, a low value suggesting an active weather system.
map.25°C = 77°F = 298.15 K，跨单位报表时统一到 K 或 °C: 25°C = 77°F = 298.15 K; unify to K or °C in cross-unit reports to avoid misreading.
map.hPa 和百帕一样吗？: Is hPa the same as hectopascal?
map.一样，1 hPa=100 Pa=1 毫巴(mbar)，气象日常混用但数值相同。: Yes, 1 hPa=100 Pa=1 millibar (mbar); meteorology uses them interchangeably but the values are identical.
map.热力学公式（如理想气体、饱和压）用绝对温度 K 才成立，℃ 直接代入会错。: Thermodynamic formulas (such as ideal gas and saturation pressure) only hold with absolute temperature K; substituting °C directly leads to errors.
map.根据日期或月龄计算月相照明率、月相名称、月升月落估算时间，并提供月相可视化图形。: Based on a date or moon age, it computes the moon phase illumination, phase name and estimated moonrise/moonset times and provides a moon phase visualization. It uses the synodic month period of 29.5306 days and the J2000 reference new moon. Runs purely on the front end; data is not uploaded.
map.支持按日期或月龄两种输入: Supports both date and moon-age inputs
map.夜钓、夜跑光线预判: Predicting light for night fishing and running
map.农历与传统节日参考: Reference for the lunar calendar and traditional festivals
